kept.spine: The Guild Council's standing at Spitzplatz is good enough to spend on the decisions the town would otherwise refuse it.
The Guild Council's standing at Spitzplatz rests on the town's prosperity, and holds no better than the prosperity does.
A stranger doing business at Spitzplatz gets one name and one answer, and can trust it enough to plan a whole season around it.
The books of several houses at Spitzplatz never show a flaw, and the flawlessness is exactly what is being paid for.
The town cannot settle on one word for how it is governed, and the hall has no better answer.

kept.poolKey: governing body name: a SLOT, never a baked noun
kept.spine: The town at Spitzplatz calls the hall by its proper title in public and something shorter everywhere else, and each usage is exact.
The Guild Council at Spitzplatz holds its seat because it remains the heavier of the two, weighed again each season.

kept.poolKey: legitimacyHold: public backing hardens the hold
kept.spine: There are people at Spitzplatz who would move against the Guild Council and do not, because unseating a ruler the town still backs costs more than the seat is worth.
